description: Schedule an existing draft for a date/time; publishes automatically then. draft_get shows who publishes it: scheduler "cloud" publishes from the cloud, no Chrome needed; "local" needs Chrome running and online (localReason says why). Use draft_create first, or draft_list for a draftId. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

at.description: Publish time, ISO 8601, must be future. Without an offset it is read in the browser's time zone (see timeZone in account_info), e.g. "2026-08-22T18:30".

draftId.description: Post id from draft_create or draft_list.

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

name: draft_schedule
title: Draft schedule
